$description: Hand-authored semantic border colours. Named presets plus aliases into the generator-emitted teal primitive ramp.

subtle.$description: Default container border — teal tint at low alpha.

strong.$description: Emphasised container border — teal tint at higher alpha.

focus.$description: Focus ring colour — alias into the primitive teal ramp at stop 400.

divider.$description: Section separator — luminance edge at near-zero alpha.

soft.$description: Soft container border — teal tint at moderate alpha. Alias-equivalent to `strong` at the same opacity.
